examples.label: Newsletter sign-up strip above the footer links
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-footer-section" site="Global" padding="large" space="small" text_position="center">
Get the monthly changelog

One email a month: what shipped, what broke, and what is coming next. One click to unsubscribe.

<.component component_name="chelekom-form-wrapper" site="Global" for={%{}} id="footer-newsletter-form" variant="transparent" space="small" class="mx-auto max-w-md text-start"> <.component component_name="chelekom-email-field" site="Global" id="footer-newsletter-email" name="email" value="" label="Email address" size="small" /> <:actions> <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" type="submit" size="small" color="primary" full_width={true}>Subscribe
